shortDescription: Show python path and assert dependency versions

options.name: dependencies
options.description: A list of version-likes or module names to check for installation. Supported operators: C(<), C(>), C(<=), C(>=), or C(==). The bare module name like V(ansible), the module with a specific version like V(boto3==1.6.1), or a partial version like V(requests>2) are all valid specifications.
